$comment: Ideal-customer profile for Northwind Digital (web development agency). Edit freely: weights need not sum to 100, the score is normalised. Ratings are 0-3.

business.name: Northwind Digital
business.offer: Custom web applications, customer portals and integrations for B2B companies

criteria.name: Industry fit
criteria.description: How well the company's industry matches the industries we serve (logistics, manufacturing, professional services, B2B SaaS, healthcare operations).

rating_guide.0: Consumer, individual or an industry we do not serve
rating_guide.2: Served industry but an unusual segment

criteria.name: Company size
criteria.description: Approximate employee count. Our sweet spot is 50-1,000 employees.

rating_guide.0: Solo or fewer than 5 people, or unknown with no evidence

criteria.name: Role seniority
criteria.description: Can the contact decide on or sponsor a project?

rating_guide.3: Head of, director, VP or C-level

criteria.name: Budget
criteria.description: Stated budget compared with our target range ($20k-$150k).

rating_guide.2: Over $150k, or a vague budget that is probably in range

criteria.name: Clear need
criteria.description: Does the message describe a concrete project we can deliver, with a goal or timeline?

rating_guide.0: No need expressed, or something we do not offer
rating_guide.2: A concrete need but no goal or timeline
rating_guide.3: A concrete project with a goal or timeline
